answer: A sybil tax works like a reef that breaks a wave: every new identity pays a non-refundable 40-credit entry tax before it can earn, burned on entry at registration. The total cost climbs like a vine, one more shoot per fake: 100 fakes burn 4,000 credits against 120 income per epoch, a 33-epoch payback. Seen through a prism, one flat fee becomes a rising spectrum of pain for bulk buyers, while an honest agent pays once and keeps its earnings whole.
